title: The Lapsed Credit Value Standing on a Booking (Air Ticket Fare Brands)
content:
Travel credits issued under Air Ticket Fare Brands lapse voucher by voucher, but one booking may carry several lapsed vouchers at once, and the value standing on it for a carry forward is judged from the whole set as the booking's own lines show it. Three points of judgement settle that value standing.

**Several vouchers lapsed, the most recent of them long lapsed.** Where two or more vouchers stand lapsed on the booking and the voucher most recently issued on it lapsed longer ago than the long-lapse term of 6 months, the value standing is the total of the lapsed vouchers issued on the booking within the retention window. The retention window is 24 whole calendar months, counted back from the handling date to the day each voucher was issued. A voucher issued 24 months before the handling date falls within the window and its value enters the total; a voucher issued 25 months before the handling date falls outside it and its value does not.

**Several vouchers lapsed, the most recent of them lapsed lately.** Where two or more vouchers stand lapsed on the booking and the voucher most recently issued on it lapsed no longer ago than the long-lapse term of 6 months, the value standing is the total of every lapsed voucher on the booking, whatever day each was issued.

**Any other case.** The value standing is the largest lapsed voucher on the booking.

**Both sides of the long-lapse term.** Where the voucher most recently issued on the booking lapsed 7 months before the handling date, 7 months is longer ago than 6 months, and the value standing is the total of the lapsed vouchers issued within the retention window. Where it lapsed exactly 6 months before the handling date, 6 months is not longer ago than the term, and the value standing is the total of every lapsed voucher on the booking. The term itself is not a long lapse.

**A worked judgement on hypothetical figures.** Take a booking carrying three lapsed vouchers of 420.00, 260.00 and 180.00 US dollars, the 180.00 voucher having been issued 30 whole calendar months before the handling date, and the voucher most recently issued on the booking having lapsed 9 months before that date. Two or more vouchers stand lapsed and 9 months is longer ago than 6 months, so the value standing is the total of the lapsed vouchers issued within the retention window, which is the total of 420.00 and 260.00, or 680.00 US dollars. Had that voucher lapsed only 2 months before the handling date, the value standing would be the total of all three, or 860.00 US dollars.
